key.name: last-notified-threshold
key.summary: Highest notified threshold in current session window

key.name: show-pace-marker
key.summary: Show the pace marker on bars
key.description: Draw a thin tick on each panel and popup bar at the elapsed share of the 5-hour or 7-day window. Its colour is the projected end-of-window usage: six tiers, as in the Claude Code skin.

key.name: bar-color-basis
key.description: usage colours a bar by the usage itself. pace colours it by usage projected to the end of the window once 15 percent of the window has elapsed, falling back to usage before that.

key.name: bar-color-mode
key.description: levels colours bars green, amber or red from the 70 and 90 percent cut-offs. single paints every panel and popup bar in the single colour below.

key.name: single-color
key.description: Hex colour used for every panel and popup bar when the bar colour mode is single.

key.name: reset-display
key.description: relative shows time left ("Resets in 1h 5m"), absolute shows the clock time ("Resets at 4:15 PM"), both shows the two together.

key.name: time-format
key.summary: Clock format for absolute reset times
key.description: system follows the GNOME clock-format setting; 12h and 24h override it.

key.name: panel-show-countdown
key.summary: Show a reset countdown in the panel
key.description: Add a compact time to reset, such as 2h or 45m, to the 5-hour panel readout.

key.name: notify-session-reset
key.description: Send one notification when the 5-hour window rolls over after a window in which usage was above zero. Needs usage notifications to be enabled.

key.name: custom-thresholds
key.description: Additional usage percentages, from 1 to 100, that notify once per 5-hour window next to the 75, 90 and 95 toggles. Values outside that range are ignored.

key.name: last-session-peak
key.summary: Highest usage seen in the current session window
key.description: Internal state: the rounded-up peak usage of the last observed 5-hour window, used to tell whether a rollover deserves a notification.

key.name: history-scale
key.description: How much history the popup chart covers: 5 hours in 15-minute buckets, 24 hours in hours, 7 days in 6-hour buckets, or 30 days in days.

key.name: history-cleared-at
key.description: Milliseconds since the epoch. Preferences set it when history is cleared; samples at or before it are discarded wherever history is read.

key.name: shortcut-toggle-menu
key.summary: Shortcut: open or close the popup

key.name: show-claude-status
key.description: Adds a row to the popup with the current status of status.claude.com. The page is requested at most every 5 minutes, only while this is on, without credentials.

key.name: skin-refresh-interval
key.summary: Claude Code statusline refresh interval; zero disables it

key.name: statusline-show-directory
key.summary: Show directory in the Claude Code skin

key.name: statusline-show-branch
key.summary: Show git branch in the Claude Code skin

key.name: statusline-show-model
key.summary: Show reasoning effort in the Claude Code skin

key.name: statusline-show-profile
key.summary: Show account profile in the Claude Code skin

key.name: statusline-show-context
key.summary: Show context window in the Claude Code skin

key.name: statusline-context-as-tokens
key.summary: Show context as a token count instead of a percentage

key.name: statusline-show-usage
key.summary: Show session usage in the Claude Code skin

key.name: statusline-pace-marker-step-colors
key.summary: Colour the pace marker by projected usage

key.name: statusline-show-weekly
key.summary: Show weekly usage in the Claude Code skin

key.name: statusline-show-extra-usage
key.summary: Show extra usage cost in the Claude Code skin

key.name: statusline-wrap-to-width
key.summary: Wrap skin segments to terminal width

key.name: statusline-line-break
key.summary: Segment that starts a second line

key.name: statusline-single-color
key.summary: Single colour for every skin element

key.name: statusline-element-color-usage
key.summary: Fixed session usage colour; empty keeps the gradient

key.name: statusline-element-color-pace
key.summary: Fixed pace marker colour; empty keeps the six tiers

key.name: statusline-element-color-weekly
key.summary: Fixed weekly usage colour; empty keeps the gradient

key.name: statusline-element-color-extra
key.summary: Fixed extra usage colour; empty keeps the gradient
